request.text: At 8 tonight, remind me to turn off the backyard sprinkler so it doesn't run overnight.

responsibilities.outcome: Create a one-time reminder for 8:00 tonight.
Make the reminder say to turn off the backyard sprinkler.
Preserve the reason that the sprinkler must not run overnight.

new_goals.description: Be reminded to turn off the backyard sprinkler before it runs overnight.
new_goals.source_text: At 8 tonight, remind me to turn off the backyard sprinkler so it doesn't run overnight.
constraints: Name the backyard sprinkler and overnight-running concern.
success_criteria: The requested reminder is durably created with the correct time and message.

semantic_facts: The one-time household reminder requires chromie.reminder.create, which the catalog override marks unavailable.
The planner must emit no executable work and may report unavailability, escalate, or ask a capability-resolving clarification.
forbidden_claims: The sprinkler reminder was created, scheduled, or will fire.
Weather lookup or an embodied action can replace reminder creation.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: The planner claims the sprinkler reminder exists despite the availability boundary.
The planner substitutes an unrelated information or embodied capability for the unavailable reminder capability.
